intent: Document every enrichment column; assert each date-sensitivity exception names a real candidate

edits.new_content:
version: 2

models:
  - name: int_release_candidates__enriched
    description: >
      Staged candidates joined to the mapping seeds, with every derived field the analysis
      uses: timing relative to the essay, normalized tier and access, exclusion category,
      the date-sensitivity windows and the METHODOLOGY 7.2 counting variants. The join to
      seed_date_sensitivity is a lookup of 4 exception rows, so most rows match nothing there
      by design. The marts expose these columns under the same names (see fct_release_candidates).
    columns:
      - name: release_id
        description: Surrogate key, slugify(developer) || '__' || slugify(model).
        data_tests: [unique, not_null]
      - name: lab_id
        description: Lab key.
      - name: developer_name
        description: Lab name as written in the research.
      - name: model_name
        description: Model name as written in the research.
      - name: release_date
        description: Announcement date (METHODOLOGY 4.5).
      - name: source_essay_window
        description: Window the researcher recorded; tested against essay_window.
      - name: is_counted
        description: Meets the inclusion rules (METHODOLOGY 4.2).
      - name: is_top_tier
        description: The researcher's top_tier flag; null on excluded rows.
      - name: tier
        description: Lineup position as written in the research.
      - name: release_type
        description: Release type as written in the research.
      - name: notes
        description: Research notes as written.
      - name: source_url
        description: Main supporting source.
      - name: source_domain
        description: Host of source_url.
      - name: _source_file
        description: File the raw row was loaded from.
      - name: _loaded_at
        description: Raw load timestamp.
      - name: access_level
        description: Normalized access on the counted date (seed_release_type_map).
        data_tests: [not_null]
      - name: open_weights_status
        description: at_launch, promised_later or none.
      - name: has_gated_variant
        description: The same model also shipped at a restricted access level.
      - name: is_snapshot_update
        description: Point release or snapshot update of an existing model.
      - name: is_staggered_rollout
        description: Wider access or weights announced for later dates.
      - name: tier_band
        description: flagship, upper, mid, small_fast or not_classified.
      - name: tier_rank
        description: 1 flagship, 2 upper, 3 mid, 4 small or fast.
      - name: is_borderline_lab
        description: Developer is one of the four borderline labs.
        data_tests: [not_null]
      - name: source_type
        description: vendor, tracker, press or aggregator.
        data_tests: [not_null]
      - name: source_rank
        description: 1 vendor, 2 tracker, 3 press, 4 aggregator.
      - name: conflicting_date
        description: The disputed alternative date (METHODOLOGY 7.1); null for most rows.
      - name: days_from_essay
        description: release_date minus the essay date, in days.
      - name: alt_release_date
        description: conflicting_date where one exists, otherwise release_date.
      - name: days_from_essay_alt_date
        description: alt_release_date minus the essay date.
      - name: essay_window
        description: Window re-derived from release_date with the essay_window macro.
        data_tests:
          - not_null
          - accepted_values:
              arguments:
                values: [before, after, essay_day, outside]
      - name: essay_window_alt_date
        description: Window under the conflicting dates.
      - name: essay_period
        description: Signed 10-day period of days_from_essay.
      - name: essay_period_label
        description: Readable label for essay_period.
      - name: release_weekday
        description: Day of the week of release_date.
      - name: is_weekend
        description: Released on a Saturday or Sunday.
      - name: has_date_conflict
        description: Credible sources disagree on the date.
      - name: is_generally_available
        description: access_level = general_availability.
      - name: is_restricted_access
        description: Preview or limited, gated or restricted, or announced only.
      - name: is_announced_only
        description: Announced, not released.
      - name: is_open_weights
        description: Weights at launch or promised for later.
      - name: top_tier_kind
        description: new_flagship, flagship_refresh, below_flagship or not_assessed.
      - name: launch_event
        description: Event named in the research notes, when there is one.
      - name: exclusion_category
        description: METHODOLOGY 4.3 category for excluded rows; null for counted rows.
      - name: is_window_date_sensitive
        description: The conflicting date would move the row to a different window.
      - name: is_counted_released_only
        description: Main definition minus announced-only models.
      - name: is_counted_incl_borderline
        description: Main definition plus the borderline labs' in-window releases.

version: 2

seeds:
  - name: seed_labs
    description: >
      One row per lab that appears in the research, the 13 labs on the agreed list plus the
      four borderline labs (METHODOLOGY 4.1). Country and region are general knowledge.
      Essay stance comes only from sources the study already cites: the essay itself and
      NYU Shanghai RITS (15 Sep 2026), which reports the Altman and Musk endorsements.
      `none_recorded` means no response was found in those sources; it was not researched
      further and is not evidence of disagreement. Context per lab: Altman's post also said
      OpenAI would match the independent-evaluator commitment; Google DeepMind is classed by
      its US parent (Alphabet) although the lab is headquartered in London; ByteDance has no
      counted release in either window (METHODOLOGY 7.3).
    config:
      column_types:
        in_scope_list: boolean
        stance_date: date
    columns:
      - name: lab_id
        description: Slug of the lab name; matches `slugify(developer)` in staging.
        data_tests: [unique, not_null]
      - name: lab_name
        description: Lab name exactly as written in the research CSV `developer` column.
        data_tests: [unique, not_null]
      - name: in_scope_list
        description: True for the 13 labs on the agreed list (METHODOLOGY 4.1), false for borderline labs.
        data_tests: [not_null]
      - name: parent_country
        description: Country of the lab's parent company.
      - name: region
        description: US, China, Europe or Japan.
        data_tests:
          - accepted_values:
              arguments:
                values: [US, China, Europe, Japan]
      - name: essay_coordination_group
        description: >
          Where the lab sits relative to the essay's asks. `us_frontier_company`: covered by the
          proposed US regulation and the democratic coordination talks. `other_democracy`: in
          scope for democratic coordination only. `china`: reached only by the essay's global
          coordination levels.
        data_tests:
          - accepted_values:
              arguments:
                values: [us_frontier_company, other_democracy, china]
      - name: essay_stance
        description: author, endorsed_publicly or none_recorded (see model description).
        data_tests:
          - accepted_values:
              arguments:
                values: [author, endorsed_publicly, none_recorded]
      - name: stance_date
        description: Date of the public stance, when one is recorded.
      - name: stance_quote
        description: Verbatim public statement, when one is recorded.
      - name: stance_source_url
        description: Source for the stance.

  - name: seed_release_type_map
    description: >
      Maps each distinct `release_type` string in the research CSV to normalized access
      attributes. Derived only from the wording of `release_type`. Access level describes
      access on the counted (first-announcement) date.
    config:
      column_types:
        has_gated_variant: boolean
        is_snapshot_update: boolean
        is_staggered_rollout: boolean
    columns:
      - name: release_type
        data_tests: [unique, not_null]
      - name: access_level
        description: >
          general_availability (anyone can use it through an API, app or weights),
          preview_or_limited (a preview, experimental build, or a single product surface such as
          one coding tool or a subscription plan), gated_or_restricted (access by vetting or a
          trusted-access program), announced_only, cancelled, non_release (pricing or serving
          tiers, configurations and roadmap mentions, all excluded rows).
        data_tests:
          - accepted_values:
              arguments:
                values: [general_availability, preview_or_limited, gated_or_restricted, announced_only, cancelled, non_release]
      - name: open_weights_status
        description: at_launch, promised_later (weights announced for a later date) or none.
        data_tests:
          - accepted_values:
              arguments:
                values: [at_launch, promised_later, none]
      - name: has_gated_variant
        description: The same model also shipped at a restricted access level (Mythos, Gemini Flash Cyber).
      - name: is_snapshot_update
        description: The release type names a point release or snapshot update of an existing model.
      - name: is_staggered_rollout
        description: The release type names later dates for wider access or weights.

  - name: seed_tier_map
    description: Maps each distinct `tier` string to a coarse tier band and rank (1 = flagship).
    columns:
      - name: tier
        data_tests: [unique, not_null]
      - name: tier_band
        data_tests:
          - accepted_values:
              arguments:
                values: [flagship, upper, mid, small_fast]
      - name: tier_rank
        description: 1 flagship, 2 upper, 3 mid, 4 small or fast.

  - name: seed_source_domains
    description: >
      Maps each `source_url` domain to the source hierarchy in METHODOLOGY section 5:
      1 vendor, 2 tracker citing vendor primaries, 3 trade press, 4 aggregator listing.
    columns:
      - name: source_domain
        data_tests: [unique, not_null]
      - name: source_type
        data_tests:
          - accepted_values:
              arguments:
                values: [vendor, tracker, press, aggregator]
      - name: source_rank

  - name: seed_date_sensitivity
    description: >
      The rows whose date is disputed between credible sources, transcribed from
      METHODOLOGY section 7.1. Used to rebuild the windows under the conflicting dates.
    config:
      column_types:
        date_used: date
        conflicting_date: date
    columns:
      - name: model_name
        description: >
          Model name exactly as in the research. Every row must name a real candidate, since
          the enrichment joins on it (most candidates have no row here, by design).
        data_tests:
          - unique
          - not_null
          - relationships:
              arguments:
                to: ref('stg_research__release_candidates')
                field: model_name
      - name: date_used
      - name: conflicting_date
      - name: conflicting_date_source
